title: docs: record-view-auditing column table lists `organization_id`, but `sys_audit_log` declares `systemFields: { tenant: false }` and read rows carry `tenant_id` only
body:
## Finding

Found by the www.objectos.ai seat 1 during the 2026-11-09 slot-ahead refresh of the record-view auditing post (www PR #284). The refresh was measured on a real `@objectstack/cli` 18.3.0 boot of `examples/app-crm`.

- `content/docs/permissions/record-view-auditing.mdx:169`, at tag `@objectstack/cli@18.3.0`, lists `tenant_id` / `organization_id` as columns of a view row.
- `sys-audit-log.object.ts:31` declares `systemFields: { tenant: false }`, and the read-audit writer stamps `tenant_id` only (`read-audit.ts` buildRow).
- On a measured 18.3.0 read row, fetched by an admin through the ledger, there is no `organization_id` key, and `tenant_id` is the contact's own org.

The spec and the runtime agree with each other. The doc page is the side that drifted.

Seam: `spec:sys_audit_log.systemFields` → `runtime:read-audit.ts` buildRow (`tenant_id` only) | docs: the record-view-auditing column table.

Reach: a public doc page. An author or auditor reading it would look for a column that does not exist.

Suggested fix: drop `organization_id` from that column table, or state that it is absent because of `systemFields: { tenant: false }`.
